_doc: Issue 1372 part B: the ONE canonical dantesync config.json per ROLE. scripts/dantesync-config-drift.sh
reads every fleet node's config (scripts/lib/dantesync-fleet.sh) and scripts/dantesync_fleet.py
compares it with its role's template here and prints a named diff. Report-only: nothing writes a
config to a box from this file. Changing a role's policy (e.g. the clock discipline, the
dantesync#117 role contract) is an edit here plus a separate, deliberate roll-out.
Clock policy (issue 1372, dantesync 1.9.0): system.clock_discipline must be absent (the default
is ptp_phase_lock) or "ptp_phase_lock"; "legacy" is drift. system.phase_slew is no longer a
policy (ptp_phase_lock ignores it), so it is {"$ignore": true}: present or absent, not graded.
Every leaf of a template must match the node. Keys starting with '_' are comments on both sides.
A node key the template does not have is reported as an extra key.
Value tokens: '@video_gm' = the video grandmaster of the role's venue: the rig grandmaster name
(scripts/lib/rig-grandmaster.sh, video-clock.lan) for video/ntp-master, the venue's grandmaster
(STRIH_DANTE_GM of its NTP-master strih fact file, issue 1412) for video-<venue>/ntp-master-<venue>;
'@audio_gm' = DANTESYNC_AUDIO_GM_HOST (scripts/lib/dantesync-fleet.sh).
Venue roles (issue 1412): video-pp / ntp-master-pp = the Poprad venue, the home-venue policy with
the PP grandmaster; a PP client's NTP upstream is the PP NTP master strih-pp.lan.
{"$optional": V} = the key may be absent, but when present it must equal V (the camboxes pass
ntp_server on the unit's --ntp-server command line, so their config has no ntp_server key).
{"$any": true} = the key must be present; any value is accepted.
{"$ignore": true} = the key is not graded: present with any value, or absent.
